listing.summary: The Valkyries. A female dominated independent military power that once occupied many undiscovered worlds and star systems in this sector. They specialize in energy damage ballistics, missiles and artillery, and their fleet is massive, with numerous unconventional capital ships.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a female-dominated military faction with specialized energy weapons and massive fleets.

description:
Valkyrians

Original mod by ValkyriaL, Originem (Original Fossic post)
Translated by persocom01

Download: Github
Download optional anime portrait replacer: Github

Requires LazyLib, GraphicsLib, MagicLib
Integrated with Nexerelin

The Valkyries. A female dominated independent military power that once occupied many undiscovered worlds and star systems in this sector. They specialize in energy damage ballistics, missiles and artillery, and their fleet is massive, with numerous unconventional capital ships. They are a formidable opponent, and should not be taken lightly unless you are confident.

Adds a faction with:
8 Capitals
7 Cruisers
5 Destroyers
5 Frigates
8 Fighter Wings
26 weapons
1 Core Star System, Enigma, located just north east of Yma
4 Portraits (15 with portrait replacer)

Campaign Mission:
Fearless Journey — seek the emotional scars left by the passage of time, and put an end to a tale of enduring love and lingering resentment

Changelog:
Spoiler
2025/6/12
mod_info.json file changed to 0.98
Changelog now readable in lunalib
Most text have been rewritten and a few translation errors corrected.

2025/2/25
valk_sunfury_torpedo.proj:
"sprite":"graphics/missiles/Torpedo_Sunfury.png", -> "sprite":"graphics/missiles/torpedo_Sunfury.png",

This change was made to perhaps fix the issue of linux errors. The change is too minor for a new release, so the version was not updated, but downloads from now on will have this change.

2025/1/29 3.3.0
Weapons
1.The on hit effect of the RW-BS Plasma Laser was changed to 20% chance of dealing 100~200 fragmentation damage when hitting a target.

Ships
1.The duration of the Burst Drive is increased by 1s, and the recharge time is doubled.
2.Adjusted the special effect of overload on Fighters.

Others
1.Adapted to 0.97a.
2.Valkyries are hostile to the Luddic Church.

2024/4/20 3.2.2
Weapons
1.Two cruise missiles speed 300->200, range 7500->6000. Spectre damage 1500->1200.
2.Heron class carrier built-in weapon Legion Tactical Plasma Launcher, damage 400->250, reload time 6->5 seconds, range 8000->4000, normalized missile existence time, missile structure 100->150

Ships
1.Reset Cherberos textures, fine-tuned others.
2.Nirvana Mk.II deployment points 35->40, ordnance points 160->180, hull integrity 12000->15000, armor rating 1350->1400, flux capacity 11000->13000, maneuverability (acceleration/deceleration) improved, shield flux/damage 1.0->0.8, added Automated Repair Unit as built-in hullmod. Built-in hullmod Cruise Hunter increase damage to cruisers 15%->20%, increase damage to destroyers 10% and 10% increased energy and ballistic weapons range.
3.New mechanism for capital ships: Holy Covenant War Program, providing attribute gains for other ships.

Fighters
1.Decrease the flux attributes of Azgard, Lightning, Firefly, and other fighters.

Others
1.Strengthened Yoshura's fleet.

Use of AI:
Translation aids: DeepL, google translate
Base portrait generation: canva
All translations were reviewed for correctness and clarified if they referred to in-game objects. All portraits have gone through modification using (mainly) microsoft paint to fix flaws, overall logic and balance of the images, a process that took between several hours to several days per portrait.
